description: Client-side script for the 'Bank Reconciliation Tool' form in ERPNext, handling setup, refresh, data fetching, rendering, and user interactions for bank reconciliation.

classes.name: NumberCardManager
classes.description: Manages display of numerical cards in the reconciliation tool.

classes.name: DataTableManager
classes.description: Handles data table display for bank transactions in the reconciliation process.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes query filters for bank account selection.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Loads necessary scripts and triggers reconciliation tool rendering.

methods.name: after_save
methods.description: Re-renders the reconciliation tool after saving the form.

methods.name: bank_account
methods.description: Fetches account currency based on selected bank account.

methods.name: bank_statement_from_date
methods.description: Triggers balance updates when statement date changes.

methods.name: make_reconciliation_tool
methods.description: Builds the reconciliation UI components based on current data.

methods.name: get_account_opening_balance
methods.description: Fetches the opening balance for the selected bank account.

methods.name: get_cleared_balance
methods.description: Fetches the cleared balance up to the statement date.

methods.name: render_chart
methods.description: Displays balance charts in the reconciliation UI.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders data tables for bank transactions.
